reference:
To determine when Stoffel Vandoorne won the Monaco GP2 Series round, I identified the paragraph that mentions his victory in the 2015 Monaco GP2 Series round: "The first race, a 40-lap feature event, was won by ART Grand Prix driver Stoffel Vandoorne who started from fourth position." The specific dates for this event are provided as 22 and 23 May 2015.

FINDING: Stoffel Vandoorne won the Monaco GP2 Series round on 22 and 23 May 2015.

descendants_plus.verifier:
KEEP The proposed answer, "22-23 May 2015," is supported by the paragraph: "[2015 Monaco GP2 Series round] The 2015 Monaco GP2 Series round was a pair of motor races held on 22 and 23 May 2015 at the Circuit de Monaco, Monte Carlo, Monaco as part of the GP2 Series. It was the third round of the 2015 GP2 season and was run in support of the 2015 Monaco Grand Prix. The first race, a 40-lap feature event, was won by ART Grand Prix driver Stoffel Vandoorne who started from fourth position. Alexander Rossi finished second for Racing Engineering, and MP Motorsport driver Sergio Canamasas came in third. Status Grand Prix driver Richie Stanaway won the second event, a 30-lap sprint race, ahead of Trident's Raffaele Marciello and Sergey Sirotkin of the Rapax team."
Final answer: 22-23 May 2015
